    def __init__(self):
        self.generation = 0
        self.rows = []
        self.decisions = {}
        self.busy = False
        self._pending_generation = None  # latest generation requested to run

    def start(self):
        self.generation += 1
        self._pending_generation = self.generation
        self.busy = True
        # preserve rows and decisions across refreshes
        return self.generation

    def poll_status(self, generation, status):
        # stale or duplicate generation returns False
        if generation != self._pending_generation:
            return False

        if status == "completed":
            # only the latest running generation transitioning to completed
            # returns True ONCE, and marks that results are pending
            self._pending_generation = None
            self.busy = True  # still busy until finish() completes
            return True

        if status == "failed":
            self._pending_generation = None
            self.busy = False
            return False

        # queued / running keep busy, no fetch yet
        self.busy = True
        return False

    def finish(self, generation, rows):
        # accept only the latest completed pending results once
        if generation != self._pending_generation or rows is None:
            return False
        self._pending_generation = None
        self.rows = list(rows)
        self.busy = False
        return True

    def set_decision(self, job_id, value):
        self.decisions[job_id] = value
